note: Reviewed per-card corrections applied by the `cards` sync step. Each entry names its reason and source. An entry may set: type, domains, noDomain, tags, championTag, copyLimit (a number or "unlimited"). Radiance entries: on 2026-11-12 the official gallery had unfinished Radiance rows (empty or wrong card type, empty or wrong domain). The sync flags such rows as incomplete by itself; an entry here repairs a row only where two sources agree (the row's own image text for the type, Piltover Archive card data for type and domain, and the set's collector-number domain blocks). Rows without a second source stay incomplete. Remove an entry once the gallery row is fixed. The `mine` list holds reviewed corrections to the card mine (plan Task 4), read by the `features` step: addTraits, removeTraits, or noMechanic (the card's text is a restriction or deck-construction rule and has no trait on purpose). The `forbiddenInteractions` list (plan Task 5) holds card pairs whose supposed combo the rules forbid, each with its rule; the `features` step drops the pair's synergy reasons whose id starts with an entry of `drop` ("*" = every synergy reason; an empty list = the pair's ordinary joins are legal and stay, only the claimed line is illegal, which the line generator must not print).

forbiddenInteractions.claim: Svellsongur on Aphelios, Exalted triggers his attach ability twice
forbiddenInteractions.reason: Copied text is added after the attach event; the ability triggers once.

forbiddenInteractions.claim: Portal Rescue on a unit taken with Possession keeps it
forbiddenInteractions.reason: Errata: its owner plays it to their base, so the unit goes back to the opponent.

forbiddenInteractions.claim: Kill a unit for Atakhan's cost and banish it with Iron Revenant to pay Atakhan's Power
forbiddenInteractions.reason: Energy and Power are paid before the kill.

forbiddenInteractions.claim: Seraphic Wyvern makes Mobilize draw when the Rune Deck is nearly empty
forbiddenInteractions.reason: Only the spell's own channel is checked.

forbiddenInteractions.claim: Seraphic Wyvern makes Catalyst of Aeons draw when the Rune Deck is nearly empty
forbiddenInteractions.reason: Only the spell's own channel is checked.

forbiddenInteractions.claim: Perched Grimwyrm played to Dragon Roost by paying the Roost cost
forbiddenInteractions.reason: "Play me only to a battlefield you conquered this turn" is a restriction; can't beats can.

forbiddenInteractions.claim: Reckoner's Arena hold fires Yone, Blademaster's conquer damage
forbiddenInteractions.reason: His own condition (the battlefield was uncontrolled) is still checked.

forbiddenInteractions.claim: Charm drags an enemy unit into your Gravity Field so that they pay
forbiddenInteractions.reason: You perform the move, so nobody pays.

forbiddenInteractions.claim: Moving two targets of Alpha Strike to base enables Repulse
forbiddenInteractions.reason: Mistargeted units still count as chosen while on the board.

forbiddenInteractions.claim: Abandon returns a spell replayed by Fizz, Trickster to hand
forbiddenInteractions.reason: "Then recycle it" applies however the spell leaves the chain.

forbiddenInteractions.claim: Stupefy on your own 1-Might empowered Gangplank, Naval gives +3 Might
forbiddenInteractions.reason: No -Might is actually given at the minimum of 1.

forbiddenInteractions.claim: Hostile Takeover then Temporal Breach keeps the stolen unit
forbiddenInteractions.reason: The owner cannot play it to your base; it stays banished.
